scene.prompt: Kaifeng, Northern Song capital on the Bian canal: crowded bridges, night markets, a pagoda over flat Henan plains
Hangzhou by the West Lake: willows, causeways, tea hills, canal boats and tiled roofs in mist
Quanzhou harbour in Fujian: ocean-going junks, twin stone pagodas, a mosque among Chinese roofs, green hills
Chengdu in the Sichuan basin: hibiscus-lined walls, brocade workshops, terraced tea hills under misty mountains
Beijing (Dadu): massive grey walls and gate towers, hutong lanes, camel caravans, snow on the Western Hills
